title: Number Merge (2048 Variant): Failure Probability Control and Perceived Randomness
subtitle: Deep dive into the core mechanics of number merge variants: dynamically adjusting failure probability thresholds for soft difficulty control, avoiding dead ends while maintaining tension. The article details the pseudo-random generation algorithm logic, ensuring a distribution that appears random but remains controlled, precisely balancing player experience with numerical stability to help developers build high-retention elimination levels.
